bullets.text: Boldyn Launches Neutral-Host 5G — Boldyn Networks installs the UK's first open-RAN neutral-host 5G at Sunderland's Stadium of Light.
Online Safety Act Concerns — The new act drives users towards risky free VPNs, exposing data to potential breaches.
UK Fibre Rollout Hits 80% — Full-fibre broadband coverage in the UK nears 80%, driven by Openreach's expansion efforts.
Full Fibre Adoption Surges — Despite a stagnant broadband market, full fibre connections in the UK have surged to 11.03 million.
EE Crowned Best Mobile Network — EE retains its title as the UK's best mobile network for the twelfth consecutive year.
Future of Wireless Trends — Key trends in wireless connectivity include AI integration, enhanced speeds, and improved security.
CSPs Face AI Challenges — Communications service providers must adapt networks to meet rising demands from agentic AI technologies.
BT Expands AWS Partnership — BT Group signs a five-year cloud partnership with AWS to enhance customer experiences.
Huawei's Chip Technology Revealed — Huawei launches the Kirin 9020 chip amid US sanctions, signaling a new transparency.
Equinix Embraces Nuclear Power — Equinix explores nuclear energy to meet rising power demands for its data centers.
